description:
About the Position

The FSR Post-doc 2027 call is funded by FSR funds and will award 15 post-doctoral 3-year fellowships within the research entities of UCLouvain. This funding aims to create favourable conditions for transnational mobility of highly qualified researchers through the award of postdoctoral fellowships. All scientific disciplines are eligible.

Funding and Benefits

  • Funding comprises a tax-exempt postdoctoral grant for 12-36 months.
  • The grant takes account of the researcher's experience.
  • Includes third-party insurance costs, social security contributions, and an operating budget.

Eligibility and Requirements

The incoming postdoctoral fellowships are intended for:

  • Experienced researchers with a doctorate.
  • Researchers with a maximum of five years' postdoctoral experience.
  • Researchers who are internationally mobile, i.e. who have not lived or carried out their main activity (work, study, etc.) in Belgium for more than 24 months in the three years prior to the project start date.
  • All nationalities are eligible.
  • Applicants must also apply to the "Chargé de recherche" instrument of the F.R.S.-FNRS call for Fellowships and Mandates, which will open in the second half of December 2026 (call closes end of January 2027).

Application Process

  1. Submission of the application (maximum one proposal per applicant) in PDF format, including application form and annexes, via the online form.
  2. The project selection process takes place in four stages:
  • Eligibility of the applications.
  • Preselection by the Research Council.
  • Top-rated proposals are evaluated by international peer reviewers.
  • Interviews by selection committee of the Research Council.
  1. Applications are assessed on the following criteria:
  • Quality of the applicant.
  • Quality of the research proposal.
  • Impact.

Contact

Sara Wilmet (ADRE/RFON-RINT)
Tel: +32 (0)10 47.38.36
Email: sar-slb@uclouvain.be

Important Notes

  • All scientific disciplines are eligible.
  • Open to all nationalities.
  • Applicants must also apply to the F.R.S.-FNRS "Chargé de recherche" instrument.
  • Calls are annual and organised once per academic year.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 23 September 2026 09:00. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
